    The fixed-hook Figure 55 backward walk #

    This file packages the two local path replacements of BGRS Figure 55 into a decreasing-index state for one fixed efficient hook tackle.

      structure LargeIndecomposable.Figure55HookRhoStage {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] {m : ℕ} (t : RayHookTackle m) {x z : RayVertex C} (p q : Quiver.Path x z) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
      Type (max u v)

      A rho-stage in the Figure 55 walk for one fixed hook tackle. The current path passes through rho_i, with nonidentity paths on both sides, and remains in the interlacement class of the fixed essential contour side.

      • left_length_ne_zero : self.left.length ≠ 0
      • right_length_ne_zero : self.right.length ≠ 0
      • state : Figure55PathState p q ((self.left.comp self.rhoPath.path).comp self.right)

          False

          The opening Figure 55 contradiction when the quiver prefix is the identity. The selected hook itself is target-incomparable with the other contour side's initial arrow, so appending that arrow gives an efficiency word which strictly extends the original word after the same final depth.

          o.after.length = 0

          Source-faithful BGRS 8.4 for an efficient hook tackle. BGRS composes paths from left to right, whereas the Lean ray quiver is reversed; hence the source's prefix p in v = p * tau * u is the occurrence's after path. It must be an identity path.
